## About

I am a physician from Ghana with a strong interest in chronic disease epidemiology, particularly cardiovascular and cardiometabolic conditions. 
My long-term goal is to design and lead clinical trials focused on non-communicable diseases in Sub-Saharan Africa, especially in Ghana. I want to gain as much practical research experience and quantitative skills, particularly in the design and implementation of clinical trials, and to understand how such trials shape public health interventions and policies. 

I have worked as a clinician since graduating from medical school, with my most recent role as a Medical Officer in the Department of Anesthesia at [Korle Bu Teaching Hospital](https://kbth.gov.gh/), Ghana’s largest tertiary referral center.

Currently, I am an MPH candidate in the Epidemiology/Biostatistics concentration at the [Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health](https://publichealth.jhu.edu/)


##### Interests
* Clinical Trials and Research
* Chronic Disease Epidemiology
* Data Analysis
